text:
Nia (Docs): Quick sync — we need the changelog entry finalized for tomorrow's push. Product wants a concise customer blurb, migration steps for embeddings, and one known-issue plus rollback sentence. Keep it PR-friendly so marketing can lift the one-liner.
Priya (PM): Customer line: 'Embeddings endpoint consolidated to /api/embeddings; update payload to use model_id by 2026-05-10.' Include the date.
Owen (SDK): I'll update Node/Python snippets. Note: Node previously used ?model=legacy; change to POST body with model_id. Also add enable_stream_fallback flag to streaming examples.
Nia (Docs): Paste exact diffs and I'll replace the code blocks.
Owen (SDK): Old curl: curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings?model=legacy -d '{"input":"hi"}'
New curl: curl https://api.redwood.ai/api/embeddings -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model_id":"embed-2026-small","input":"hi"}'
Streaming python old: client.generate_stream(prompt)
New: client.generate_stream(prompt, enable_stream_fallback=True)
Also Go import path needs changing from "github.com/redwood/sdk" to "github.com/redwood/inference-go/sdk" in our examples.
Ravi (I18n): I need the source strings in key/value form for FR/DE/JP. Keep each under 120 chars.
Nia (Docs): Source strings: changelog.embeds.announce = "Embeddings endpoint consolidated; migrate to /api/embeddings with model_id by 2026-05-10." changelog.embeds.known_issue = "Some legacy clients sending 'model' may receive 400s; use the migration shim or update payloads."
docs-ci: lint/linkcheck initially failed on branch release/embeds-fix (found refs to /v1/embeddings); fixes pushed and CI re-run.
Priya (PM): Rollback sentence: if you see >5% error-rate after migration, contact support to request temporary aliasing for 48h while you update clients. Keep concise.
Nia (Docs): Adding a short "If you see issues" paragraph linking to /ops/runbooks/changelog-rollback and support@redwood.ai. Also adding the migration shim example header X-Legacy-Model: true.
Owen (SDK): Opening PR 5211 with all snippet updates. Ran snippet-tests locally.
docs-ci: build passed on branch release/embeds-fix (linkcheck fixed, snippet-tests passed) :white_check_mark:
Nia (Docs): Final checklist: 1) swap snippets (Owen) 2) update Go import (Owen) 3) add known-issue + rollback link (Nia) 4) i18n keys queued (Ravi) 5) PM sign-off (Priya) 6) docs-ci green.
Priya (PM): Approving copy and rollback wording.
Nia (Docs): Merging after docs-ci green and will publish to staging. Marketing one-liner will be posted after deploy. Thanks team. :rocket:
